mLocKeys.keySummary: Illaoi rips the spirit from a foe's body, forcing it to stand before her. Spirits echo a percentage of the damage they take to the original target. If killed, or if the target gets too far from the spirit, the target will become a <font color='#669900'>Vessel</font> and begin spawning Tentacles.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Illaoi pulls the spirit from an enemy champion for @SpiritDuration@ seconds. The spirit can be damaged like a champion, with @EchoPercent@ of that damage echoing to its owner.

If the spirit dies or the target leaves its range, the target becomes marked for @VesselDuration@ seconds and is Slowed by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds. Marked enemies spawn Tentacles if possible.

Tentacles will automatically Slam at spirits and marked enemies once every @TimeBetweenVesselTentacleSlams@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Marked enemies are revealed for a short time.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>I am but a Vessel</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is a <font color='#669900'>Vessel</font> and will be attacked by nearby Tentacles. <font color='#669900'>Vessels</font> will also periodically spawn Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Prophet of an Elder GodIllaoi draws the presence of her god, spawning a Tentacle on nearby impassible terrain if no other Tentacles are nearby (@f1@ second cooldown). Tentacles will not attack on their own, but can be made to Slam by Illaoi's abilities.

Slam deals @f2@ (+@f3@) (+@f5@) physical damage. If Slam damages one or more enemy champions, Illaoi is healed for @f4*100@% of her missing health.

Enemies hit by multiple Slams at once take 50% damage beyond the first.
Tentacles last until killed or Illaoi is out of range for 1 minute.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Illaoi and the <font color='#669900'>Vessels</font> she creates spawn Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain. Tentacles swing at spirits, <font color='#669900'>Vessels</font>, and victims of Illaoi's Harsh lesson. Tentacles deal physical damage to enemies hit, and will heal Illaoi if they damage a champion.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Illaoi draws the presence of her god, spawning a Tentacle on nearby terrain if no other Tentacles are nearby (@SpawnCD@ second cooldown). Tentacles will not attack on their own, but can be made to Slam by Illaoi's Abilities.

Slam deals @spell.IllaoiQ:TentacleDamageTotal@ physical damage. Hitting at least one enemy champion restores @MissingHPPercentHeal*100@% missing Health to Illaoi.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_IllaoiPassive_Tooltip}}

Enemies hit by multiple Slams at once take 50% damage for the second and 25% damage for all additional Slams.
Tentacles last until killed or Illaoi is out of range for @TentacleDisabledLifetime@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Increases the damage dealt by Tentacles. When activated, Illaoi smashes down a Tentacle that deals physical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Slam damage is increased by @spell.IllaoiQ:TentacleDamageAmp*100@% (currently @spell.IllaoiQ:TentacleDamageTotal@ physical damage).

Active: Illaoi swings her idol, causing a Tentacle to Slam forward.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Leap of Faith</titleLeft><mainText>Illaoi's Harsh Lesson has a reduced cooldown.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Illaoi smashes her idol into the ground, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies. A Tentacle spawns for each enemy champion hit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Illaoi smashes her idol into the ground, dealing @DamageCalc@ physical damage to nearby enemies and spawning a Tentacle for each enemy champion hit.

For the next @Duration@ seconds, Tentacles are untargetable and Slam 50% faster, and Harsh Lesson has a @spell.IllaoiW:CooldownDuringR@ second cooldown.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Spirits from <spellName>Test Of Spirit</spellName> also generate a Tentacle if hit by this ability.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Harsh Lesson</titleLeft><mainText>Illaoi's next basic attack gains additional range, causes her to dash to her target, and deals bonus physical damage. On hit, nearby Tentacles will also swing at the target.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Illaoi leaps to her target, dealing physical damage and causing nearby Tentacles to also swing at the target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Illaoi's next Attack causes her to leap at the target, dealing an additional <physicalDamage>@HealthPercentTotal@ max Health physical damage</physicalDamage>. When she strikes, nearby Tentacles will <keywordMajor>Slam</keywordMajor> at the target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
The percent Health damage does a minimum of @WMinDamage@. Against jungle monsters the damage is capped at @MonsterDamageCap@.
